name: @pipeworx/mcp-xposedornot

tools.name: email_breaches
tools.description: Check whether an email address appears in known data breaches. Free lookup, no key: returns the list of breach names the address was found in (e.g. LinkedIn, Adobe), or breached=false. For per-breach detail — what data was exposed, dates, risk score — follow up with email_breach_analytics.

tools.name: email_breach_analytics
tools.description: Detailed breach-exposure report for an email address: every breach it appears in with breach date, records affected and which data classes leaked (passwords, phone numbers, addresses), plus an overall risk score/label, password-strength breakdown and paste exposures. Free, no key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-xposedornot forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the xposedornot pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
